items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Is that the name, Bella? Yeah, they take over.

ctx.x: It cost you a thousand dollars to hire enough policemen to take them away.

That's right. That's really a fact. You never have many police, you've got to have your help in the parade. When they get in that procession, and as you go along, you're picking them up. About a 20, 150 cent. They got a gang down there that's the umbrella game. They comes out with their own umbrellas. Well, I've seen that crowd and they can really be kind of rough. They is rough. They too rough. And that's the street not on food with them because they too rough. They don't worry me because I don't parade. And I…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Every year. Every year president.
